name: dm-logistic
description: DM Logístic — controle de estoque e logística para outlet (web + Android + iOS via Capacitor).

scripts.mobile:setup: npm i @capacitor/core @capacitor/android @capacitor/ios && npm i -D @capacitor/cli @capacitor/assets && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios
scripts.android: npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
